announcements.headline: Notification of Half Year 2026 Results
announcements.insight: As a pure-play diamond miner with high fixed costs and limited operational leverage, Gem Diamonds' half-year results are critical for assessing cash flow resilience amid volatile global demand; this update serves as a vital barometer for the sector's ability to sustain dividends or manage debt without dilutive capital raises.

announcements.headline: Notification of H1 2026 Trading Update
announcements.insight: As a small-cap miner with high operational leverage to diamond price volatility, this H1 update is critical for validating the viability of the Jwaneng mine's transition and cost management strategies amidst current softening global demand.
